subject: SIG: proposed change request & re-answer workflow
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cloudtrust.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG update — v2 change log and re-answer request

Hi Rishi,

CloudTrust published a minor SIG revision this morning (we're calling it v2). The change log touches ~24 question IDs across the Availability and Data Protection sections — several questions were reworded and a handful were split/merged.

Can Redwood provide re-answers for the changed items and a canonical "diff + re-answers" package we can attach to our inventory? Our procurement and security teams prefer a single spreadsheet with the old answer, new answer, justification, and evidence link.

Attached: SIG_v2_change_log.pdf (high-level mapping).

Requested deadline: 2027-03-12 COB. If that's tight, let me know an alternate window. Also indicate one internal owner we can work with for clarifications.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Senior Security Program Manager
CloudTrust Inc.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cloudtrust.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG update — v2 change log and re-answer request

Lena — thanks for the heads up and for the change log.

Short answer: we can do the re-answers by 2027-03-12 COB, provided we get the raw question IDs or an export (so we don't miss split/merged IDs). I'm looping in Neha (security) to coordinate the control owners and Marissa for legal attestation if anything changes materially.

Next steps I propose:
- Neha to map control owners and produce the initial re-answer spreadsheet.
- Karthik (legal/engineering) to review any rephrased wording that might impact contract language — Marissa will route as needed.
- Rishi will provide point-of-contact to CloudTrust and confirm final delivery format.

I've attached a quick planning workbook: SIG_reanswer_plan.xlsx (internal).

If you can share the raw export or a question-id list, that'll speed things up.

-Rishi
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-06T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG update — v2 change log and re-answer request

Thanks Rishi. Per plan — I'll own the mapping and initial re-answers. Quick clarifying questions:

1) Do we treat merged questions as new GUIDs (i.e., create combined answers) or provide an explicit mapping row for "Q_old1 + Q_old2 -> Q_new"? I recommend the latter so CloudTrust can trace back.

2) For evidence: I'll collect existing artifacts (policy links, SOC 2 map, architecture diagram). Is a single ZIP with pointers acceptable or do you prefer individual Drive links per question?

Proposed internal timeline:
- 2027-03-07: draft mapping + re-answer columns populated (internal).
- 2027-03-09: internal review with Karthik for redlines and Marissa for legal flags.
- 2027-03-11: finalize and export canonical diff spreadsheet.

I'll start the spreadsheet now and share a working copy.

-Neha
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cloudtrust.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudTrust Security Team <security@cloudtrust.com>
Date: 2027-03-07T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG update — v2 change log and re-answer request

Neha — thanks, that mapping approach is perfect.

A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Attached is a small export with the new question GUIDs and a delta flag: sig_delta_export.json (note: internal IDs are canonical for v2).
- For merged items please include both predecessor IDs in the mapping rows (as Neha suggested).
- Drive link to v2 canonical doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD-CT-SIG-diff

Deadline remains 2027-03-12 COB. If you foresee a specific question that requires additional time due to evidence collection, flag it and we'll accept a short extension per-question.

Lena

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-09T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG update — v2 change log and re-answer request

Neha + team — quick legal/engineering note:

- When you populate "justification", avoid language that looks like a policy change ("we now encrypt x"). Stick to facts and evidence pointers ("policy X dated yyyy, encryption in transit: TLS1.3, see architecture diagram v3"). If wording would imply a new control we should record it as an operational change and run it through change control.
- For any question where the answer shifts from a procedural statement to an attested control (e.g., from "we are evaluating" to "we enforce"), loop Marissa so we can confirm attestation scope.

I can allocate time on 2027-03-09 afternoon for a 30m redline pass.

-Karthik
Staff Counsel (Tech Transactions)
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cloudtrust.com>
Date: 2027-03-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG update — v2 change log and re-answer request

Team — good work on the draft mapping. Final plan and immediate actions:

- Neha: please finalize the canonical spreadsheet (SIG_reanswers_v1.xlsx) and put evidence links in-column where available; for heavy artifacts, attach a single ZIP (evidence_pack_stub.zip) and include per-question pointer. Target: EOD today (2027-03-12).
- Karthik: confirm you can do the 30m redline pass after Neha's submission; escalate any attestation scope changes to Marissa.
- Marissa: please hold on attestation review; only required if Karthik flags changes.
- Lena: once we upload the final spreadsheet to your Drive link, can CloudTrust attach it to the inventory in place of individual answers? That will simplify downstream procurement checks.

I will upload the spreadsheet and stub evidence to the Drive link and message you when done. Thanks all for quick turnaround on short notice.

-Rishi
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
